baseline_finding: The four-way ablation enumerates all cross-products of separate minimal-core families and evaluates unions against the joint intervention table. The initial sample had 168/168 sufficient unions; a fixed-seed expanded sample across 30 Docker workloads analyzed 239 alert cases and found 335/335 unions sufficient, with at least one joint-minimal union in every case. Nine controlled fixtures also had all 11 unions sufficient. An independently table-checked witness still has two insufficient crossed unions. The exact Boolean criterion reduces to joint-minimal-set containment and is not a policy-structure characterization; all workload evidence is retrospective and alert-conditioned.
required_action: Derive and verify a nontrivial policy-structure-specific composability result beyond minterm containment, or reduce the novelty claim; evaluate prespecified non-alert and independent realistic cases; report the bounded counterexample alongside the absence of observed workload failures.
